name: Cobblestone
description: Rounded cobblestones laid in staggered courses, every stone a little different in shape, set and shade.

code.style: --rule: ( @y(even) { transform: translateX(50%); } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --t: translate(@r(-3%, 3%), @r(-3%, 3%)) rotate(@r(-6deg, 6deg)); --rd: @r(28%, 48%) @r(28%, 48%) @r(28%, 48%) @r(28%, 48%) / @r(28%, 48%) @r(28%, 48%) @r(28%, 48%) @r(28%, 48%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 28%, var(--color5) 0, transparent 58%), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); border-radius: @var(--rd); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 5%; bottom: 5%; left: -95%; width: @match(x == 1, 90%, 0); background: radial-gradient(circle at 34% 28%, var(--color5) 0, transparent 58%), @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); border-radius: @var(--rd); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
